_about: Who each name in the TUF archive is, and how that was decided. Generated by scripts/tuf/resolve_identity.mjs from ufc_fighters and ufc_bouts; the season files carry the resulting ids. Edit the script or name_aliases.json, never this file.

_tiers.alias: asserted in name_aliases.json with the bout that proves it
_tiers.exact: the printed name equals exactly one fighter name
_tiers.normalized: equal to exactly one fighter name once accents, punctuation, case, a quoted nickname and a parenthesised note are removed; no word is dropped
_tiers.exact_with_evidence: several fighters share the exact name and exactly one has bout evidence for the season
_tiers.convention: a spelling convention (suffix, initials, given-name variant, extra surname) accepted only with bout evidence: a UFC bout against a resolved castmate, a bout on the season finale date, or, for spellings that keep the surname, a UFC debut within 540 days after the finale
_tiers.season_spelling: a second spelling of a castmate inside the same season: that castmate's printed nickname, or a recorded convention matching exactly one other printed name of the season

_guard: A contestant resolved without evidence must have a UFC career within eight years of the season on either side, except in seasons cast from UFC veterans. A namesake a decade away is rejected, not linked.

f5785bba-c6f8-45de-8682-d044d586c8ac.proof: ESPN athlete 3108776 (the ESPN-keyed row) competed on 2014-05-31, 2014-12-20 and 2015-12-12, losing each time; those are exactly the three UFC bouts held by the UFC Stats-keyed row d53482bef23235ba. On 2015-12-12 the ESPN opponent is athlete 2504639, which is Court McGee in ufc_fighters, the recorded winner of that bout. Both rows carry the nickname "Lyoto"; the birth dates disagree by two days (1989-05-03 ESPN, 1989-05-05 UFC Stats), the source disagreement that created the pair.
